targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, splitByChar(':', label)[1] AS counter, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM market.aeron_counters WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND type = 'system' AND delta IS NOT NULL AND (label IN ('Bytes sent', 'Bytes received', 'NAKs sent', 'NAKs received', 'Short sends', 'Retransmits sent', 'Client liveness timeouts') OR label LIKE 'Errors%') GROUP BY time, counter ORDER BY time

panels.title: Subscriber behind publisher (bytes)

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.ts AS time, concat(toString(p.stream_id), ' ', if(s.client_name = '', toString(s.owner_id), s.client_name)) AS subscriber, max(p.value - s.value) AS behind FROM market.aeron_counters AS p INNER JOIN market.aeron_counters AS s ON p.ts = s.ts AND p.session_id = s.session_id AND p.stream_id = s.stream_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.ts) AND p.type = 'pub-pos' AND s.type = 'sub-pos' GROUP BY time, subscriber ORDER BY time

panels.description: pub-pos minus each sub-pos of the same session: how far each subscriber lags.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.ts AS time, concat('recording ', toString(r.recording_id)) AS recording, max(p.value - r.value) AS behind FROM market.aeron_counters AS p INNER JOIN market.aeron_counters AS r ON p.ts = r.ts AND p.session_id = r.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.ts) AND p.type = 'pub-pos' AND r.type = 'rec-pos' GROUP BY time, recording ORDER BY time

panels.title: Publisher headroom before back pressure (bytes)

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.ts AS time, concat(toString(p.stream_id), ' ', p.client_name) AS publication, min(l.value - p.value) AS headroom FROM market.aeron_counters AS p INNER JOIN market.aeron_counters AS l ON p.ts = l.ts AND p.registration_id = l.registration_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.ts) AND p.type = 'pub-pos' AND l.type = 'pub-lmt' GROUP BY time, publication ORDER BY time

panels.description: pub-lmt minus pub-pos: room left before offers are back-pressured.

targets.rawSql: SELECT owner_id AS client_id, argMax(client_name, ts) AS name, argMax(label, ts) AS heartbeat, max(ts) AS seen FROM market.aeron_counters WHERE type = 'client-heartbeat' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE GROUP BY owner_id ORDER BY owner_id

SELECT type, stream_id, session_id, channel, client_name, argMax(value, ts) AS position FROM market.aeron_counters WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE AND stream_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY type, stream_id, session_id, channel, client_name ORDER BY stream_id, type
SELECT last_observed, count, error FROM market.aeron_errors WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY last_observed DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT last_observed, observations, bytes_lost, session_id, stream_id, channel, source FROM market.aeron_loss WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY last_observed DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Feeds: who publishes where (last 30 s)

targets.rawSql: SELECT host, stream_id, session_id, argMax(client_name, ts) AS client, argMax(channel, ts) AS publication, argMax(value, ts) AS position FROM market.aeron_counters WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 SECOND AND type = 'pub-pos' AND startsWith(channel, 'aeron:udp') GROUP BY host, stream_id, session_id ORDER BY stream_id, host

panels.description: Every UDP feed publication by node: after a move a stream shows up under its new host with a new session.

panels.title: Receivers behind senders, by stream and node (bytes)

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.time AS time, concat(toString(s.stream_id), ' ', s.host, ' → ', r.host) AS receiver, max(s.pos - r.pos) AS behind FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 5 SECOND) AS time, host, session_id, stream_id, max(value) AS pos FROM market.aeron_counters WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND type = 'snd-pos' GROUP BY ALL) AS s INNER JOIN (SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 5 SECOND) AS time, host, session_id, stream_id, max(value) AS pos FROM market.aeron_counters WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND type = 'rcv-pos' GROUP BY ALL) AS r ON s.time = r.time AND s.session_id = r.session_id AND s.stream_id = r.stream_id GROUP BY time, receiver ORDER BY time

panels.description: snd-pos on the publisher's node minus rcv-pos on each subscriber's node, per 5 s: across nodes, unlike the panel above.

panels.title: MDC destinations per feed

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(host, ' :', extract(label, 'control=[^:]+:(\\d+)')) AS feed, max(value) AS destinations FROM market.aeron_counters WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND type = 'mdc-num-dest' GROUP BY time, feed ORDER BY time

panels.description: Subscribers (other nodes' drivers) each feed is sending to. A subscriber that follows a moved publisher leaves one node's count and joins another's.

panels.title: NAKs, retransmits and loss per node / s

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(host, ' ', label) AS series, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM market.aeron_counters WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND type = 'system' AND label IN ('NAKs sent', 'NAKs received', 'Retransmits sent', 'Loss gap fills') GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Reliable streams repair loss with NAKs and retransmits; best-effort ones (tob) never NAK.

panels.title: Name re-resolutions per node (a publisher moved)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, host, sum(delta) AS changes FROM market.aeron_counters WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND type = 'system' AND startsWith(label, 'Resolution changes') GROUP BY time, host ORDER BY time

panels.description: The driver re-resolves a subscription's control name after 5 s without data; a change means the publisher's name now points at another node.
